title: Lufthansa Tragedy in Bengaluru, the FTC Comes for Fare Pricing, and a Tiramisu That Could Get You Drug Tested
summary: A somber start today — a Lufthansa crew member died in a hotel pool electrocution in India, and we talk about why these incidents keep happening. Then: the FTC makes the personalized pricing investigation official, American pilots get warned off a boozy dessert, Amadeus admits a three-year data breach hit half the industry, and layoffs keep piling up from Anchorage to Riga.
